codex.thesift.baton.body: Strikes as hard as a sword. Use it to flick a single sonic note down the line you point at, hurting the first creature in its way. It needs a moment to recover between notes.
codex.thesift.baton.title: Conductor's Baton
codex.thesift.bulb.body: Bulbs hop all over the plains, squashing on every landing and leaving a little trail of tinted slime. Feed them Pitcher Bulbs to breed them; happy Bulbs plop out Glowing Slime Balls. Play music and they dance. Four colours: sky, blossom, dusk and the rare starry.
codex.thesift.bulb.title: Bulb
codex.thesift.chrome.body: A shifting cyan pearl liquid. Soaking in Chrome heals you, but it is thick like quicksand and you sink slowly: hold Shift to rise. Collect it with a bucket.
codex.thesift.chrome.title: Chrome
codex.thesift.chrome_well.body: Little wells of Chrome in the plains and dunes, often with a chest of Chrome Pearls and buckets hidden nearby.
codex.thesift.chrome_well.title: Chrome Well
codex.thesift.deep_shrine.body: Hushslate shrines in the caves of the Deep Sift. Each holds an Echo Frame - your way home - and a chest that sometimes keeps a Warden Core. Riveters roost nearby.
codex.thesift.deep_shrine.title: Deep Shrine
codex.thesift.dictator.body: Tall, thin and terribly fast. He slashes with his baton, blinks behind you and calls his orchestra. At 60% he rolls rings of sound across the floor - jump them - and calls a Warden. Below 25% he moves faster still and drowns the arena in darkness.
codex.thesift.dictator.title: The Dictator
codex.thesift.enchoer.body: A big mound of mint fur with moose antlers and a melancholy face. Enchoers trade saplings, seeds, drums, pearls and the occasional Warden Core. Play music near one and it spreads its arms and hums along. It hides its face when hurt.
codex.thesift.enchoer.title: Enchoer
codex.thesift.enforcer.body: A living drum. When you get close it raises both mallets - that is your warning - and beats its own drum head: a shockwave rolls out along the ground. Jump as it lands.
codex.thesift.enforcer.title: Enforcer
codex.thesift.euphory_altar.body: Set an item on the altar, surround it with Sift Drums and feed it a Chrome Pearl. The drums play themselves, the rings spin up and the item comes out enchanted beyond what a table can do.
codex.thesift.euphory_altar.title: Euphory Altar
codex.thesift.flora.body: Coral Bushes and tall Coral Thickets grow thick across the salmon Coral Turf of the Sift Plains, under pale weeping Lullwood trees.
codex.thesift.flora.title: Coral Flora
codex.thesift.harmoner.body: Feed a Harmoner seeds and it sings, takes off and leads you somewhere, waiting if you fall behind. Its colour tells you where: Rose - Abandoned Altar. Azure - Chrome Well. Gold - Dream Statue. Violet - Collapsed Tower. Jade - Sift Ruins. Coral - Musical Temple. The rare Night - the Sculk Castle.
codex.thesift.harmoner.title: Harmoner
codex.thesift.howler.body: A pipe organ on four legs. When its back pipes glow it is drawing breath - get out from in front of it before it blasts a cone of sound that throws you far back.
codex.thesift.howler.title: Howler
codex.thesift.music.body: Many Sift creatures react to music: Bulbs dance, Enchoers hum, Harmoners sing along and Riveters fall still. Soul Chimes ring when powered; Dream Snares lull whatever steps in them to sleep.
codex.thesift.music.title: Music & Chimes
codex.thesift.musical_temple.body: Old temples of song. Tune each Harmony Stone to the colour of its pedestal to open the vault below.
codex.thesift.musical_temple.title: Musical Temple
codex.thesift.portal.body: Find the great frame in an Ancient City. Set a Sift Drum beside it with a Warden Core inside and three Sculk Sensors nearby, then play: the drum calls a rhythm, you answer it on the drum. Three rounds right and the frame fills with portal.
codex.thesift.portal.tagline: A rhythm at the Ancient City
codex.thesift.portal.title: The Way In
codex.thesift.resonator.body: A spidery harp strung with sculk tendons. It keeps its distance, draws a string back and lets it snap: a singing line that cuts and drags you towards it. Close in fast.
codex.thesift.resonator.title: Resonator
codex.thesift.riveter.body: It hangs head-down from cave ceilings in the Deep Sift with its long claws dangling. When it sees you it flings its arms open and screams - and every Warden nearby comes running. Sneak past it, or play music to lull it.
codex.thesift.riveter.title: Riveter
codex.thesift.ruins.body: Sift Ruins, Collapsed Towers, Abandoned Altars and Dream Statues are scattered across the surface. Brush suspicious dreamsand for relics and read the Dream Journal Fragments you find.
codex.thesift.ruins.title: Ruins & Statues
codex.thesift.sculk_castle.body: A tower of sculk and hushslate. Inside, a spiral of steps climbs the wall - jump the gaps, mind the crumbling ones, rest at the lantern ledges. Slime catches you if you fall. On the roof waits the Conductor's Podium. Step up to it.
codex.thesift.sculk_castle.title: The Sculk Castle
codex.thesift.sift_cake.body: Baked from Glowing Slime Balls and Sift produce. Each slice restores a little hunger and leaves you glowing softly for a moment.
codex.thesift.sift_cake.title: Sift Cake
codex.thesift.sift_sniffer.body: Feed a wild Sniffer Pitcher Bulbs or torchflower seeds until it trusts you, then put a saddle on it and climb up. A ridden Sniffer ploughs straight through soft ground in its way and every so often lifts its nose and marks buried treasure nearby with a trail of glowing dust.
codex.thesift.sift_sniffer.tagline: Tame it, saddle it, ride it
codex.thesift.sift_sniffer.title: Sniffer
codex.thesift.sifter.body: A box of a head with a lid that snaps open like a trap. Sifters burrow in the dunes with only the lid showing and burst out when you come close. Watch the sand for a lid that breathes.
codex.thesift.sifter.title: Sifter
codex.thesift.siftite.body: Smelt Serbim ore into ingots and alloy them with copper to make Siftite. Siftite tools and armour are upgraded from copper gear at a smithing table with the Siftite Upgrade template, found in temples and towers.
codex.thesift.siftite.title: Siftite Gear
codex.thesift.slingshot.body: Fires Glowing Slime Balls. A fully drawn shot bursts into light where it lands - and a direct hit on a Warden leaves it Deafened, unable to hear you for a while.
codex.thesift.slingshot.title: Slingshot
codex.thesift.slumbler.body: Huge, wide-mouthed and mostly asleep. Slumblers lounge in the Chrome lakes, yawn enormously and drop Thick Hide - and sometimes a Chrome Pearl. Let sleeping Slumblers lie: they bite.
codex.thesift.slumbler.title: Slumbler
codex.thesift.vocals.body: When the Dictator reaches his crescendo, a Warden claws up through the floor to sing for him. A Glowing Slime Ball from a slingshot leaves it Deafened.
codex.thesift.vocals.title: The Vocals
codex.thesift.warden_core.body: Taken from a Warden or found in the deepest shrines. Set into a Sift Drum, it lets the drum lead the rhythm ritual that opens the way to The Sift.
codex.thesift.warden_core.title: Warden Core
item.thesift.smithing_template.siftite_u: Add copper armor, weapon, or tool

message.thesift.drum.need_sensors: The drum needs at least three Sculk Sensors nearby to listen...
message.thesift.drum.no_frame: No portal frame answers the drum. Build one of Echo Frames or find an Ancient City gate.
message.thesift.drum.opened: The way to The Sift is open.
message.thesift.drum.your_turn: Your turn - play the rhythm back!

message.thesift.harmoner.guide.coral: The Coral Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Musical Temple!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.gold: The Gold Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Dream Statue!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.jade: The Jade Harmoner sings and takes off towards the Sift Ruins!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.night: The Night Harmoner sings a dark little tune and takes off towards the Sculk Castle...
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.rose: The Rose Harmoner sings and takes off towards an Abandoned Altar!
message.thesift.harmoner.guide.violet: The Violet Harmoner sings and takes off towards a Collapsed Tower!
message.thesift.harmoner.lost: The Harmoner tilts its head. It cannot sense any place of its colour nearby.
message.thesift.sniffer.tamed: The Sniffer nuzzles you. It trusts you now - give it a saddle and ride it!
message.thesift.sniffer.treasure: Your Sniffer smells treasure %s blocks away!
